title: VPC telemetry stack Terraform module with upgrade lifecycle and self-heal checks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that provisions the observability stack for Private (VPC) deployments: Prometheus (operator + Alertmanager), Grafana with dashboard provisioning, an OpenTelemetry Collector deployment/config, and log-shipping (S3/ELK/Vector) primitives. The module must support safe upgrades (module versioning, preflight plan diffs, canary upgrade strategy for k8s deployments or replacement order for managed services), built-in health checks, and automatic remediation hooks that trigger self-healing (recreate, restart, or fallback to a compatible variant). The module will be usable for both EKS and non-EKS (EC2/VM) targets via clear provider abstractions and input flags. It must include: inputs for retention/replica sizing, network/security options (subnets, SGs, IAM roles/KMS keys), export targets for logs, and toggleable managed vs. self-hosted components. The goal is a single module that reduces operator toil when creating or upgrading telemetry in customer VPCs while minimizing blast radius and preserving state integrity.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module accepted in registry with semantic versioning and README
Module can deploy core stack (Prometheus operator + Alertmanager, Grafana, OTEL collector, log-shipping) into a customer VPC with minimal inputs
CI pipeline runs terraform plan and executes a preflight verification layer that validates metric ingestion, dashboard provisioning, and log sink connectivity
Upgrade path exercised: minor module version bump performs zero-downtime rolling upgrade in canary namespace and then batch rollout
Health checks surface to Redwood Console: scrape health metrics, OTEL pipeline status, and log forwarder status; alerts fire correctly and remediation automation can recover a simulated failure
Security review completed and module passes automated KMS/IAM lint checks
implementation_notes: Structure: modules/observability/vpc-telemetry with submodules: prometheus, grafana, otel-collector, logship
Prometheus: prefer kube-prometheus-stack pattern (CRDs) for k8s; for non-k8s provide AM/managed Prometheus integration
Grafana: use provisioning files via terraform provider; pre-populate dashboard JSONs and a few canonical Redwood dashboards
OTEL: deploy collector as a DaemonSet/Deployment with version pinning and canary label support; include a config generator template for pipelines
Log shipping: support Vector and fluentd outputs; implement optional S3/Elastic endpoints with KMS encryption
Upgrade strategy: add 'canary_namespace' input and 'max_unavailable' controls; CI will run a dry-run plan and smoke tests against the canary prior to global apply
State and drift: recommend remote state with locking; include a migrate.md explaining steps for major schema changes

Self-heal: implement a small lambda / k8s operator pattern that runs periodic health checks (scrape endpoint + OTEL readiness + log sink ack) and can create a PR or trigger terraform apply to recreate density scaled resources
Observability outputs: module should export graph datasource IDs, Prometheus targets list, and Alertmanager endpoints via outputs
IAM/KMS: include least-privilege policy templates and a toggle to integrate with customer KMS
